notes: The standalone poofin row is LVL_IMMORT at POS_DEAD and reaches SCMD_POOFIN in the shared setter (R1/R2/R5e).
An empty post-skip-spaces remainder frees the old POOFIN value, stores NULL, and still emits global OK (R1/R4/R5e).
A non-empty remainder is stored verbatim after C skip_spaces; internal spacing is not token-normalized (R1/R3/R5e).
A custom message with internal spacing receives the exact OK acknowledgement.
The existing goto matrix owns the destination-room consumer of POOFIN; this slice owns only the setter's exact stored state (R5b/R5c).
SCMD_POOFOUT reaches the same do_poofset setter and is owned by the next source-order command slice (R5b/R5c).
